dedupe_keys.name: nfpa us fire department profile supporting tables firefighters departments stations apparatus and calls 2020 edition

description: These supporting tables accompany the NFPA report US Fire Department Profile 2020 and describe the size and resources of US fire departments. They were compiled by Rita Fahy, Ben Evarts and Gary P. Stein of the National Fire Protection Association's research division and published in September 2022. The figures come from the NFPA Survey of Fire Departments for US Fire Experience during 2020 and the NFPA Fire Service Survey for 2018 to 2020. The 22 tables give career and volunteer firefighters by sex and population protected, firefighter rates per 1,000 residents by region and community size, age and tenure profiles, the number of departments and the share of population protected by department type, average apparatus and station rates, pumpers, other suppression vehicles, aerial apparatus and stations by community size, calls by incident type and year, departments providing emergency medical service and direct spending on local fire protection; appendices give long-run series of departments, stations and apparatus. Coverage is national. The PDF is free to download online; NFPA retains copyright. Caveats: values are survey estimates with sampling error, and the 2020 edition is the latest found. Simulation uses: station, apparatus and staffing densities for fire service capacity and response models. Related records: the USFA National Fire Department Registry (data-usfa-national-fire-department-registry) lists departments, and NFPA firefighter fatality reports (data-nfpa-fatal-firefighter-injuries-united-states) cover losses.
